title: Padded-hex Gleam escapes smuggle U+2014 past the em-dash lint
detail: Gleam accepts 1-6 hex digits in \u{...} escapes, so "\u{02014}" compiles to U+2014 (verified with gleam 1.15.1) but find() only matches the canonical spelling. Probe: padded forms passed the lint, canonical flagged.
recommended_fix: Match the escape grammar, not the literal: regex \u\{([0-9a-fA-F]{1,6})\} in has_em_dash, decode the codepoint, flag when it is 0x2014. Add padded-hex probes to negative controls.
